ja: うちの新機能を、ユーザーは知らないよ。
en: Users have no idea what we've launched.
alternatives: Users don't know what we've launched.
Users haven't a clue what we've launched.
Users have no clue what we've launched.
point: 「知らない」は have no idea で強める。what 節は肯定の語順

ja: 機能を少し減らそう。
en: Let's cut some features.
alternatives: Let's trim a few features.
Let's reduce the features a bit.
point: 「〜しよう」は Let's + 動詞

ja: 我々が出すのは試作品です。
en: What we're shipping is a prototype.
alternatives: We're releasing a prototype.
Our upcoming release is a prototype.
point: what 節で出すものをひとまとまりにする。

ja: ユーザーに試すよう頼んで。
en: Ask users to try it.
alternatives: Get users to try it.
Ask users to test it.
point: ask + 人 + to 動詞。命令文でも同じ形

ja: 我々は公開を遅らせるべき。
en: We should delay the release.
alternatives: We should wait before releasing.
We should hold the release.
point: should で公開を急がず待つべきだと伝える。

ja: この機能は、削るべきだった。
en: We should have cut this feature.
alternatives: We should've dropped this feature.
We should have removed this feature.
point: 過去の後悔は should have + 過去分詞

ja: これは優先度が少し低いかも。
en: This might be a slightly lower priority.
alternatives: This may be a bit lower priority.
I think this could be a slightly lower priority.
point: might / slightly で断定をやわらげる

ja: あの機能、早く切ればよかった。
en: I wish we'd axed that feature sooner.
alternatives: I wish we'd killed that feature earlier.
I wish we'd cut that feature sooner.
point: 「切る」は axe。過去の後悔は wish + 過去完了

ja: その機能、いつ出るかわかる？
en: Do you know when that feature ships?
alternatives: Do you know when that feature is released?
Do you know when that feature will launch?
point: 間接疑問は when + 主語 + 動詞の語順

ja: 私が決めるなら、それは廃止するね。
en: If it were my call, I'd scrap it.
alternatives: If I decided, I'd scrap it.
If I had the say, I'd scrap it.
point: 「私が決めるなら」は If it were up to me

ja: 通知を減らすのはどうかな？
en: How about reducing notifications?
alternatives: What about reducing notifications?
Why not reduce notifications?
point: How about の後は -ing

ja: このボタンの方が大きい。
en: This button is bigger.
alternatives: This button's larger.
This is the larger button.
point: bigger でボタンのサイズを比較する。

ja: もうリリースした？
en: Have you released it yet?
alternatives: Have you shipped it yet?
Have you already released it?
point: 「もう〜した？」は Have you ～ yet?

ja: こっちのほうが安い。
en: This one is cheaper.
alternatives: This one costs less.
This one is less expensive.
point: 短い形容詞は cheaper のように er

ja: ユーザーが増えてるよ。
en: Users are increasing.
alternatives: We're getting more users.
The number of users is growing.
point: 変化の途中は進行形 are ～ing

ja: 我々は利用者の感想が必要。
en: We need user feedback.
alternatives: We need feedback from users.
We need users' opinions.
point: feedback は数えないので a をつけない。

ja: 不満なのは登録の流れだよ。
en: It's the sign-up flow users complain about.
alternatives: It's the sign-up flow that users dislike.
The sign-up flow is what users complain about.
point: It is 〜 that 〜 で不満の対象を強調する

ja: 結局、誰向けの機能？
en: Who is this feature actually for?
alternatives: Who's this feature really for?
Who is this feature meant for?
point: 前置詞 for は文末に残せる

ja: オフラインでも使えるよ。
en: You can use it offline.
alternatives: It works offline too.
You can even use it offline.
point: 「できる」は can + 動詞の原形

ja: 公開後、利用者が倍増した。
en: Users have doubled since launch.
alternatives: Our user count has doubled since launch.
The number of users has doubled since launch.
Users doubled after the launch.
point: since と結果の今への影響は現在完了

ja: 手軽でも登録は暗黙の強制に当たる。
en: Though frictionless, sign-up amounts to tacit coercion.
alternatives: Despite its ease, signing up involves implicit coercion.
Though easy, sign-up is effectively subtle coercion.
point: tacit は暗黙の、coercion は強制。

ja: 先にユーザーに聞くべき。
en: We should ask users first.
alternatives: We should ask the users first.
We ought to ask users first.
point: 「〜すべき」は should + 動詞

ja: 皆ずっとダークモードを求めてる。
en: Everyone's been clamoring for dark mode.
alternatives: Everyone's been begging for dark mode.
Everyone's been asking for dark mode for ages.
point: 「ずっと〜してる」は have been doing

ja: 彼女は注目と需要を混同するなと言った。
en: She said not to conflate attention with demand.
alternatives: She said not to confuse attention with demand.
She said not to mistake attention for demand.
point: conflate A with B は別のものを混同する。

ja: 離脱防止のために作った。
en: We built it to prevent churn.
alternatives: We made it to prevent churn.
We built this to reduce churn.
point: 目的は to + 動詞の原形

ja: 資金難で私たちは新機能を見送る。
en: Lacking funds, we're shelving extra features.
alternatives: Short of funds, we're postponing extra features.
We're shelving extra features because money's tight.
point: shelve は計画などの実行を見送ること。

ja: 今回は見送ったほうが無難かも。
en: We might be better off skipping it.
alternatives: We may be better off skipping this one.
Maybe we should skip this one for now.
point: might be better off で控えめに提案する

ja: 私たちがケチってたら駄作を出してた。
en: Had we skimped, we'd have shipped a dud.
alternatives: If we'd skimped, we'd have shipped a dud.
We'd have released a dud if we'd cut corners.
point: skimp は必要な手間や費用まで切り詰めること。

ja: これでユーザーはうちに夢中になる。
en: That'll get users hooked on us.
alternatives: That'll have users hooked on us.
That'll make users obsessed with us.
point: 「夢中にさせる」は get / have + 人 + hooked

ja: 今、テストしてるよ。
en: I'm testing it now.
alternatives: I'm testing it right now.
I'm testing this now.
point: 「〜してる」は be + ～ing

ja: ボタンが二つあるよ。
en: There are two buttons.
alternatives: We have two buttons.
It has two buttons.
point: 複数は There are + 複数名詞

ja: この通知を消して。
en: Remove this notice.
alternatives: Delete this notification.
Get rid of this notice.
point: remove は表示や機能を取り除く。

ja: その時初めて解約理由に納得した。
en: Only then did churn make sense.
alternatives: Only then did I understand the churn.
The reason for churn finally clicked then.
point: Only then did は「その時初めて」を強める倒置。

ja: バグは金曜に修正されます。
en: The bug will be fixed Friday.
alternatives: They'll fix the bug on Friday.
The bug gets fixed on Friday.
point: 修正「される」は受動態。行為者は言わない

ja: これ、いい案だね。
en: It's a good idea.
alternatives: That's a good idea.
This is a good idea.
point: idea は数えられるので a をつける

ja: 先に出せていれば、解約は少ない。
en: If we'd shipped first, churn would be lower.
alternatives: If we had shipped it first, churn would be lower.
If we'd shipped sooner, churn would be lower.
point: 過去の仮定 + 今の結果は if had + would be

ja: 地味なのに人気の機能だ。
en: Although it's unglamorous, it's popular.
alternatives: Even though it's plain, it's popular.
It's a plain feature, but it's popular.
point: 「〜なのに」は although / even though

ja: 君、これ使える？
en: Can you use this?
alternatives: Can you work with this?
Can you operate this?
point: Can you で可能かを尋ねる。

ja: 先月、ダークモードを出した。
en: We shipped dark mode last month.
alternatives: We released dark mode last month.
We launched dark mode last month.
point: last month があれば過去形 shipped

ja: CEO は来期モバイル優先と言った。
en: The CEO said mobile comes first next quarter.
alternatives: The CEO said mobile is the priority next quarter.
The CEO said mobile would come first next quarter.
point: said の後は時制をずらすか、変わらない事実なら現在形

ja: 公開前に我々は需要を測ってた。
en: We'd gauged demand before launch.
alternatives: Before launch, we'd assessed demand.
We'd measured demand before releasing it.
point: had gauged で公開より前の判断を表す。

ja: この画面は新しい。
en: This screen is new.
alternatives: This is a new screen.
The screen is new.
point: new はこれまでなかったもの。

ja: 私たちが折れてたら今は客が激減だ。
en: Had we capitulated, we'd now be hemorrhaging customers.
alternatives: If we'd given in, we'd now be hemorrhaging customers.
We'd be hemorrhaging customers now had we capitulated.
point: 過去の仮定で今の結果を表す、hemorrhage は大量に失う。

ja: ユーザーが望むのは速い検索。
en: What users want is fast search.
alternatives: What users want is faster search.
Users want fast search, above all.
point: What 節が主語。want の目的語は抜ける

ja: 月曜に新プランを公開する。
en: We're launching the new plan Monday.
alternatives: We're releasing the new plan Monday.
The new plan goes live Monday.
point: 決まった予定は進行形で言える

ja: 公開したら教えて。
en: Tell me when it's released.
alternatives: Let me know when it ships.
Tell me once it's released.
point: when 節は未来でも現在形

ja: この機能は一か月先送りにしよう。
en: Let's push this feature back a month.
alternatives: Let's delay this feature by a month.
Let's put this feature off for a month.
point: 「先送りする」は push back / put off

ja: 先週届いた要望を整理しよう。
en: Let's sort the requests received last week.
alternatives: Let's go through the requests we received last week.
Let's sort through last week's requests.
point: requests の後ろに received を置いて説明を足す

ja: 新機能を試してもらえますか？
en: Mind giving the new feature a whirl?
alternatives: Could you try the new feature?
Could you give the new feature a try?
point: give something a whirl は気軽に試す。

ja: 画面を簡単に、と彼に頼んだ。
en: I asked him to simplify the screen.
alternatives: I asked him to simplify this screen.
I asked him to make the screen simpler.
point: ask + 人 + to 動詞。that 節にしない
